name: refuse-file-write-grant
text:
A write grant that names a file is refused, and the refusal names the
directory to grant.

A grant is a directory prefix: the module documentation of
`crates/core/src/grants.rs` states so, and `RootWriter` opens every write root
as a directory with `Dir::open_ambient_dir`. A lead dividing work across a team
narrows each worker to the unit it was given, and a unit is often one file. The
runtime (`crates/core/src/spawn.rs`) accepts that narrowing, records it as the
child's `effective_write`, and then cannot open it: the worker fails during
construction with

    grants.write: Not a directory (os error 20)

which names neither the worker nor the call that made it. The worker's episode
log is created and left empty, the lead reads only "exited without
episode/end" and does the work itself, and the run reports `completed` with a
units list naming workers that never ran.

A `spawn` call whose write narrowing names a file is refused at the call,
before any child is constructed. The refusal states that the root names a file and names the
directory that holds the file as the one to grant, so that the lead can act on
the message. A narrowing to a directory is accepted.

checks/run.sh runs the checks this task is judged on: the tests of foe-core, clippy with warnings denied on the same crates, and scripts/loc.sh.

Follow AGENTS.md. Run the checks it names. When you finish, or when you cannot, report your outcome.
